verdict.rationale: The Agent Toolkit exposes create_refund and get_refund functions callable programmatically by AI agents, explicitly covering agent-placed orders since the same toolkit's create_order/pay_order tools initiate those orders, and dispute-tracking tools (list_disputes, get_dispute, accept_dispute_claim) complement refund tracking. Webhooks provide event-driven tracking of refund status changes with documented reliability/retry behavior. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of refund initiation on agent-placed orders specifically, and no documented end-to-end example tying an ACP/UCP agent checkout to a subsequent refund flow.
